# Matchday Insights

> A world ranking of every senior men's football (soccer) club - about 3,145 clubs in some 150 countries - on one rating scale, so a club in Kenya, Japan or Uruguay can be compared directly with one in England or Spain. Updated several times a day. Free, no account.

How the rating works: an Elo-style rating. Every senior result moves both clubs' ratings - a win over a stronger side gains more than a win over a weaker one, and the margin of victory counts. Continental results also move the strength of the clubs' whole league, which is how leagues on different continents are put on one scale. Odds for each match come from the two ratings and home advantage. More: https://matchdayinsights.com/about.html

Track record: 225,507 matches replayed with the ratings as they stood before kick-off; the chances we give are off by 0.4 percentage points on average (when we say 60%, it happens about 60% of the time). Full record: https://matchdayinsights.com/track-record.html

Updated: 20 November 2026

## Main pages

- World club ranking: https://matchdayinsights.com/index.html
- A club's page: https://matchdayinsights.com/clubs/<club>.html - world rank, rank in its country, rating chart since 2021, every result, next matches with our odds
- Best club in each country: https://matchdayinsights.com/countries/<country>.html (e.g. https://matchdayinsights.com/countries/japan.html) and the map https://matchdayinsights.com/best-club-in-every-country.html
- Strongest leagues in the world: https://matchdayinsights.com/leagues.html; a league: https://matchdayinsights.com/leagues/<league>.html (table, odds of the title and relegation)
- Match predictions with our odds next to the bookmakers': https://matchdayinsights.com/predictions.html; a match: https://matchdayinsights.com/predictions/<home>-vs-<away>-<date>.html
- Results and fixtures with live scores: https://matchdayinsights.com/matches.html
- National team ranking (all 211 FIFA members): https://matchdayinsights.com/nations.html
- How accurate the odds are: https://matchdayinsights.com/track-record.html
- This month's ranking for the press (free to quote with a link): https://matchdayinsights.com/press.html
- The world title belt (a lineal club title, won by beating the holder): https://matchdayinsights.com/belt.html
